📜 Apps Script code to deploy
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // MADIO CRM — Google Apps Script Backend (Production v2) // Deploy as Web App: Execute as Me, Access: Anyone // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ const SS = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet(); const LOCK_TIMEOUT = 8000; // ms // ── Sheet name map ───────────────────────────────────────────── const SHEET_MAP = { Quotes_2026:'Quotes_2026', Sales_Register:'Sales_Register', Visitors:'Visitors', Navaki_Leads:'Navaki_Leads', Inventory:'Inventory', Petty_Cash:'Petty_Cash', Architects:'Architects', Tasks:'Tasks', Purchase_Orders:'Purchase_Orders', Vouchers:'Vouchers', Attendance:'Attendance', Roles:'Roles', _meta:'_meta' }; function getOrCreate(name) { return SS.getSheetByName(name) || SS.insertSheet(name); } // ── doGet: read a sheet or check delta ──────────────────────── function doGet(e) { try { const action = e.parameter.action || 'read'; const sheet = e.parameter.sheet || 'Quotes_2026'; if(action === 'delta') return getDelta(sheet, e.parameter.since); if(action === 'ping') return out({ok:true, ts: Date.now(), sheets: Object.keys(SHEET_MAP)}); return readSheet(sheet); } catch(err) { return out({error: err.message}); } } function readSheet(name) { const ws = getOrCreate(name); const data = ws.getDataRange().getValues(); if(data.length === 0) return out({sheet:name, rows:[], count:0}); const headers = data[0]; const rows = data.slice(1) .filter(r => r.some(c => c !== '' && c !== null)) .map(r => { const o={}; headers.forEach((h,i)=>{ if(h) o[h]=r[i]; }); return o; }); return out({sheet:name, count:rows.length, rows, ts:Date.now()}); } // Delta sync: only rows changed after 'since' timestamp function getDelta(name, since) { const sinceTs = parseInt(since) || 0; const ws = getOrCreate(name); const data = ws.getDataRange().getValues(); if(data.length === 0) return out({sheet:name, rows:[], delta:true, since:sinceTs}); const headers = data[0]; const tsIdx = headers.indexOf('_updated_at'); if(tsIdx < 0) return readSheet(name); // no timestamp col, return all const rows = data.slice(1) .filter(r => parseInt(r[tsIdx])||0 > sinceTs) .map(r => { const o={}; headers.forEach((h,i)=>{ if(h) o[h]=r[i]; }); return o; }); return out({sheet:name, rows, delta:true, since:sinceTs, ts:Date.now()}); } // ── doPost: write operations ────────────────────────────────── function doPost(e) { try { const p = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents); const lock = LockService.getScriptLock(); lock.waitLock(LOCK_TIMEOUT); try { if(p.action === 'push_all') return pushAll(p); if(p.action === 'upsert') return upsertRow(p); if(p.action === 'append') return appendRow(p); if(p.action === 'delete') return deleteRow(p); if(p.action === 'init_headers')return initHeaders(p); if(p.action === 'batch_upsert')return batchUpsert(p); return out({error:'Unknown action: '+p.action}); } finally { lock.releaseLock(); } } catch(err) { return out({error: err.message, stack: err.stack}); } } // Full replace function pushAll(p) { const ws = getOrCreate(p.sheet); ws.clearContents(); if(p.rows && p.rows.length > 0) { ws.getRange(1,1,p.rows.length, p.rows[0].length).setValues(p.rows); } logMeta(p.sheet, 'push_all', p.rows ? p.rows.length-1 : 0); return out({ok:true, count: p.rows ? p.rows.length-1 : 0}); } // Upsert by ID field function upsertRow(p) { const ws = getOrCreate(p.sheet); const data = ws.getDataRange().getValues(); const headers = data[0] || []; const idIdx = headers.indexOf(p.idField || 'id'); const now = Date.now(); // Add _updated_at let tsIdx = headers.indexOf('_updated_at'); if(tsIdx < 0) { ws.getRange(1, headers.length+1).setValue('_updated_at'); headers.push('_updated_at'); tsIdx = headers.length-1; } // Build row array from object const row = headers.map((h,i) => h === '_updated_at' ? now : (p.row[h] !== undefined ? p.row[h] : (data[1] ? data[1][i] : ''))); // Find existing if(idIdx >= 0 && p.row[p.idField || 'id']) { for(let i=1; i { const row = headers.map(h => h==='_updated_at' ? now : (rec[h]!==undefined?rec[h]:'')); const rid = String(rec[p.idField||'id']||''); if(rid && idMap[rid]) { ws.getRange(idMap[rid],1,1,row.length).setValues([row]); } else { toAppend.push(row); } }); if(toAppend.length > 0) ws.getRange(ws.getLastRow()+1,1,toAppend.length,toAppend[0].length).setValues(toAppend); return out({ok:true, upserted: (p.rows||[]).length}); } function initHeaders(p) { (p.sheets||[]).forEach(s => { const ws = getOrCreate(s.name); if(ws.getLastRow() === 0) ws.getRange(1,1,1,s.headers.length).setValues([s.headers]); }); return out({ok:true}); } // Metadata log function logMeta(sheet, action, count) { try { const ws = getOrCreate('_meta'); ws.appendRow([new Date(), sheet, action, count, Session.getActiveUser().getEmail()]); } catch(e) {} } function out(o) { return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(o)) .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON); }
